zh: 乌普萨拉大学（Uppsala University）成立于1477年，位于瑞典乌普萨拉省乌普萨拉市，是瑞典历史最悠久的大学之一，也是欧洲顶尖的研究型大学。学校在自然科学、医学、社会科学、人文艺术等领域享有盛誉，其学术研究水平位居世界前列。乌普萨拉大学以其深厚的学术传统和优美的校园环境，培养了大量各领域的杰出人才。
en: Uppsala University, founded in 1477, is one of Sweden's oldest universities and a leading European research institution in Uppsala, Uppsala County. It excels in natural sciences, medicine, social sciences, humanities, and more, with world-leading academic research. Known for its profound academic tradition and beautiful campus, Uppsala University has produced numerous talents across fields.
